name: claude-api
description:
Reference for the Claude API / Anthropic SDK — model ids, pricing, params, streaming, tool use, MCP, agents, caching, token counting, model migration.
TRIGGER — read BEFORE opening the target file; don't skip because it "looks like a one-liner" — whenever: the prompt names Claude/Anthropic in any form (Claude, Anthropic, Fable, Opus, Sonnet, Haiku, `anthropic`, `@anthropic-ai`, `claude-*`, `us.anthropic.*`, `[1m]`); the user asks about an LLM (pricing/model choice/limits/caching) — never answer from memory; OR the task is LLM-shaped with provider unstated (agent/MCP/tool-definition/multi-agent/RAG/LLM-judge/computer-use; generate/summarize/extract/classify/rewrite/converse over NL; debugging refusals/cutoffs/streaming/tool-calls/tokens).
SKIP only when another provider is being worked on (overrides all triggers): OpenAI/GPT/Gemini/Llama/Mistral/Cohere/Ollama named in the query; OR `grep -rE 'openai|langchain_openai|google.generativeai|genai|mistralai|cohere|ollama'` over the project hits (run this grep FIRST if no provider named — don't Read the file).
descriptionPt: Referência da API da Claude / SDK da Anthropic — ids de modelo, preços, parâmetros, streaming, uso de ferramentas, MCP, agentes, cache, contagem de tokens, migração de modelo. GATILHO — leia ANTES de abrir o arquivo alvo; não pule porque "parece uma linha só" — sempre que: o prompt citar Claude/Anthropic em qualquer forma (Claude, Anthropic, Fable, Opus, Sonnet, Haiku, `anthropic`, `@anthropic-ai`, `claude-*`, `us.anthropic.*`, `[1m]`); o usuário perguntar sobre um LLM (preço/escolha de modelo/limites/cache) — nunca responda de memória; OU a tarefa tiver forma de LLM sem provedor declarado (agente/MCP/definição de ferramenta/multiagente/RAG/LLM como juiz/uso do computador; gerar/resumir/extrair/classificar/reescrever/conversar sobre linguagem natural; depurar recusas/cortes/streaming/chamadas de ferramenta/tokens). PULE apenas quando outro provedor estiver em jogo (isso vence todos os gatilhos): OpenAI/GPT/Gemini/Llama/Mistral/Cohere/Ollama citados na pergunta; OU `grep -rE 'openai|langchain_openai|google.generativeai|genai|mistralai|cohere|ollama'` no projeto der resultado (rode esse grep PRIMEIRO se nenhum provedor for citado — não leia o arquivo).

name: academy-guide
description: Stop and check this skill before finishing any reply to a question about how to use Claude or a Claude product — it recommends matching courses, tutorials, and use cases from Claude Academy (academy.claude.com), Anthropic's learning hub. Trigger on: "how do I", "how can I", "getting started with", "what can Claude do", "teach me", "learn to use"; questions about artifacts, projects, skills, plugins, connectors, MCP; requests about rolling Claude out to a team, class, or organization; and any ask for training materials, onboarding content, or learning resources. Use it when the user is learning how to use a feature or product — not when they are mid-task and just want the task done. This skill composes with other skills: after consulting product documentation to answer how a Claude feature works, also check here for a matching course or tutorial — a docs-grounded answer and an Academy recommendation belong together. Only recommend on a strong match; never invent Academy content.
descriptionPt: Pare e consulte esta skill antes de finalizar qualquer resposta sobre como usar a Claude ou um produto Claude — ela recomenda cursos, tutoriais e casos de uso correspondentes da Claude Academy (academy.claude.com), o hub de aprendizado da Anthropic. Dispara em: "como eu", "como posso", "começando com", "o que a Claude faz", "me ensina", "aprender a usar"; perguntas sobre artefatos, projetos, skills, plugins, conectores, MCP; pedidos sobre implantar a Claude em um time, turma ou organização; e qualquer pedido de material de treinamento, conteúdo de onboarding ou recursos de aprendizado. Use quando o usuário está aprendendo a usar um recurso ou produto — não quando está no meio de uma tarefa e só quer a tarefa pronta. Esta skill se combina com outras: depois de consultar a documentação do produto para explicar como um recurso da Claude funciona, verifique aqui também se há um curso ou tutorial correspondente — uma resposta fundamentada na documentação e uma recomendação da Academy andam juntas. Só recomende quando a correspondência for forte; nunca invente conteúdo da Academy.

name: discernment-nudge
description: After you give a substantive answer or draft that the user may act on — advice or recommendations, drafted artifacts such as goals, plans, pitches, proposals, or emails, estimates or projections, analysis or interpretation of data, factual claims they may rely on, or a multi-step argument — invoke this skill BEFORE finalizing your reply and then, if it applies, append 2-3 short follow-up questions, each tied to something specific in what you just produced, that help the user check key facts, probe the reasoning or assumptions, and notice missing context. Do this at most once per conversation. Skip it when the user asked a trivial how-to or simple lookup, wants a purely educational explanation, asked you only to format, convert, or assemble a file from content they provided, is writing code they will run, is doing creative writing or casual chat, or already asked you to double-check, cite, or review — the skill file explains these boundaries and the exact output format.
descriptionPt: Depois de dar uma resposta substantiva ou um rascunho sobre o qual o usuário pode agir — conselhos ou recomendações, artefatos redigidos como metas, planos, pitches, propostas ou e-mails, estimativas ou projeções, análise ou interpretação de dados, afirmações factuais das quais ele pode depender, ou um argumento de várias etapas — invoque esta skill ANTES de finalizar a resposta e então, se couber, acrescente de 2 a 3 perguntas curtas de acompanhamento, cada uma ligada a algo específico do que você acabou de produzir, que ajudem o usuário a conferir fatos-chave, sondar o raciocínio ou as premissas e perceber contexto ausente. Faça isso no máximo uma vez por conversa. Pule quando o usuário pediu um how-to trivial ou uma consulta simples, quer uma explicação puramente didática, pediu apenas para formatar, converter ou montar um arquivo a partir de conteúdo que ele forneceu, está escrevendo código que ele mesmo vai rodar, está fazendo escrita criativa ou conversa casual, ou já pediu para você conferir, citar fontes ou revisar — o arquivo da skill explica esses limites e o formato exato de saída.

name: audit-context-building
description: Understand a codebase before looking for bugs in it - what each function assumes, what it guarantees, and what it depends on elsewhere. Use when starting an audit, threat model, or architecture review on unfamiliar code, and before any vulnerability-hunting pass.
descriptionPt: Entenda uma base de código antes de procurar bugs nela — o que cada função pressupõe, o que ela garante e do que depende em outros pontos. Use ao iniciar uma auditoria, modelagem de ameaças ou revisão de arquitetura em código desconhecido, e antes de qualquer passada de caça a vulnerabilidades.

name: differential-review
description: Performs security-focused differential review of code changes. Adapts analysis depth to codebase size, uses git blame for context, calculates blast radius by counting callers, checks test coverage of modified code, and generates a markdown report. Use when reviewing a PR, commit, or diff for security vulnerabilities, checking whether a change re-introduces a previously fixed bug, asking what else a change could break, or finding which modified code has no test covering it.
descriptionPt: Faz revisão diferencial de mudanças de código com foco em segurança. Adapta a profundidade da análise ao tamanho da base de código, usa git blame como contexto, calcula o raio de impacto contando os chamadores, checa a cobertura de testes do código modificado e gera um relatório em markdown. Use ao revisar um PR, commit ou diff em busca de vulnerabilidades, checar se uma mudança reintroduz um bug já corrigido, perguntar o que mais uma mudança pode quebrar, ou descobrir qual código modificado não tem teste cobrindo.

name: testing-handbook-generator
description: Generates Claude Code skills from the Trail of Bits Testing Handbook (appsec.guide), analyzing handbook pages and emitting SKILL.md files with the structure each skill type requires. Use when creating or refreshing a skill from handbook content, or when the user names the testing handbook or appsec.guide. Not for answering security testing questions — the generated skills cover those.
descriptionPt: Gera skills do Claude Code a partir do Testing Handbook da Trail of Bits (appsec.guide), analisando páginas do handbook e emitindo arquivos SKILL.md com a estrutura que cada tipo de skill exige. Use ao criar ou atualizar uma skill a partir do conteúdo do handbook, ou quando o usuário citar o testing handbook ou appsec.guide. Não serve para responder perguntas sobre testes de segurança — as skills geradas é que cobrem isso.

name: audit-prep-assistant
description: Prepares codebases for security review using Trail of Bits' checklist. Helps set review goals, runs static analysis tools, increases test coverage, removes dead code, ensures accessibility, and generates documentation (flowcharts, user stories, inline comments). Use when preparing your own codebase to be audited by someone else, getting a repository review-ready before an external security review, deciding what to fix before auditors start, or asking what assessors need from a project. For understanding unfamiliar code you are about to audit, use audit-context-building instead.
descriptionPt: Prepara bases de código para revisão de segurança usando o checklist da Trail of Bits. Ajuda a definir objetivos da revisão, roda ferramentas de análise estática, aumenta a cobertura de testes, remove código morto, garante acessibilidade e gera documentação (fluxogramas, histórias de usuário, comentários no código). Use ao preparar sua própria base de código para ser auditada por outra pessoa, deixar um repositório pronto para revisão antes de uma auditoria externa de segurança, decidir o que corrigir antes de os auditores começarem, ou perguntar o que os avaliadores precisam de um projeto. Para entender código desconhecido que você está prestes a auditar, use audit-context-building.

name: code-maturity-assessor
description: Systematic code maturity assessment using Trail of Bits' 9-category framework. Analyzes codebase for arithmetic safety, auditing practices, access controls, complexity, decentralization, documentation, MEV risks, low-level code, and testing, then produces a scorecard with evidence-based ratings and a priority-ordered roadmap. Use when assessing or scoring the maturity of a smart contract or blockchain codebase, producing a maturity scorecard or evaluation, or judging how mature, well-tested, or well-documented such a project is against a rubric.
descriptionPt: Avaliação sistemática de maturidade de código usando o framework de 9 categorias da Trail of Bits. Analisa a base de código quanto a segurança aritmética, práticas de auditoria, controles de acesso, complexidade, descentralização, documentação, riscos de MEV, código de baixo nível e testes, e então produz um scorecard com notas baseadas em evidências e um roteiro ordenado por prioridade. Use ao avaliar ou pontuar a maturidade de um smart contract ou base de código blockchain, produzir um scorecard ou avaliação de maturidade, ou julgar o quanto tal projeto é maduro, bem testado ou bem documentado frente a uma rubrica.

name: gh-cli
description: Enforces authenticated gh CLI workflows over unauthenticated curl, WebFetch, and MCP fetch patterns. Use when working with GitHub URLs, API access, pull requests, or issues.
descriptionPt: Impõe fluxos autenticados com a CLI gh no lugar de padrões não autenticados de curl, WebFetch e busca via MCP. Use ao trabalhar com URLs do GitHub, acesso à API, pull requests ou issues.

name: guidelines-advisor
description: Smart contract development advisor based on Trail of Bits' best practices. Analyzes codebase to generate documentation/specifications, review architecture, check upgradeability patterns, assess implementation quality, identify pitfalls, review dependencies, and evaluate testing. Use when asking whether a smart contract project follows development best practices, reviewing on-chain/off-chain split, upgradeability, or delegatecall proxy patterns against guidelines, or seeking recommendations on contract design, inheritance, events, documentation, dependencies, or test strategy.
descriptionPt: Consultor de desenvolvimento de smart contracts baseado nas boas práticas da Trail of Bits. Analisa a base de código para gerar documentação/especificações, revisar arquitetura, checar padrões de atualizabilidade, avaliar qualidade de implementação, identificar armadilhas, revisar dependências e avaliar testes. Use ao perguntar se um projeto de smart contract segue boas práticas de desenvolvimento, revisar a divisão on-chain/off-chain, atualizabilidade ou padrões de proxy com delegatecall frente às diretrizes, ou buscar recomendações sobre design de contrato, herança, eventos, documentação, dependências ou estratégia de testes.

name: secure-workflow-guide
description: Guides through Trail of Bits' 5-step secure development workflow. Runs Slither scans, checks special features (upgradeability/ERC conformance/token integration), generates visual security diagrams, helps document security properties for fuzzing/verification, and reviews manual security areas. Use when securing a smart contract end to end rather than hunting one bug, checking a project on every check-in or before deployment, triaging a Slither report, or asking where to start on smart contract security.
descriptionPt: Conduz pelo fluxo de desenvolvimento seguro em 5 etapas da Trail of Bits. Roda varreduras do Slither, checa recursos especiais (atualizabilidade/conformidade ERC/integração de tokens), gera diagramas visuais de segurança, ajuda a documentar propriedades de segurança para fuzzing/verificação e revisa áreas de segurança manuais. Use ao proteger um smart contract de ponta a ponta em vez de caçar um bug específico, checar um projeto a cada commit ou antes do deploy, triar um relatório do Slither, ou perguntar por onde começar em segurança de smart contracts.

name: token-integration-analyzer
description: Token integration and implementation analyzer based on Trail of Bits' token integration checklist. Analyzes token implementations for ERC20/ERC721 conformity, checks for 20+ weird token patterns, assesses contract composition and owner privileges, performs on-chain scarcity analysis, and evaluates how protocols handle non-standard tokens. Use when integrating or accepting arbitrary ERC20/ERC721 tokens, auditing a token implementation for standards conformity, or assessing risk from weird tokens such as fee-on-transfer, rebasing, missing return values, or blocklists.
descriptionPt: Analisador de integração e implementação de tokens baseado no checklist de integração de tokens da Trail of Bits. Analisa implementações de tokens quanto à conformidade com ERC20/ERC721, verifica mais de 20 padrões de tokens estranhos, avalia a composição do contrato e os privilégios do dono, faz análise de escassez on-chain e avalia como protocolos lidam com tokens fora do padrão. Use ao integrar ou aceitar tokens ERC20/ERC721 arbitrários, auditar a implementação de um token quanto à conformidade com os padrões, ou avaliar o risco de tokens estranhos como taxa na transferência, rebasing, ausência de valor de retorno ou listas de bloqueio.

name: c-review
description: Performs comprehensive C/C++ security review for memory corruption, integer overflows, race conditions, and platform-specific vulnerabilities. Use when auditing native C/C++ applications, reviewing daemons or services for memory safety, or hunting integer overflow / use-after-free / race conditions in userspace code.
descriptionPt: Faz revisão de segurança abrangente de C/C++ para corrupção de memória, overflows de inteiro, condições de corrida e vulnerabilidades específicas de plataforma. Use ao auditar aplicações nativas em C/C++, revisar daemons ou serviços quanto à segurança de memória, ou caçar overflow de inteiro / use-after-free / condições de corrida em código de espaço de usuário.

name: panel-review
description: Reviews a code target by launching a panel of specialist auditor agents and merging their reports. Use when asked to run a panel review.
descriptionPt: Revisa um alvo de código lançando um painel de agentes auditores especialistas e mesclando seus relatórios. Use quando pedirem uma revisão em painel.

name: review-pr
description: Reviews the current branch's changes against its base branch as a pull request: correctness of new and modified code, test coverage for it, and documentation accuracy. Use when asked to review a branch, a diff, or a pull request.
descriptionPt: Revisa as mudanças do branch atual contra o branch base, como um pull request: correção do código novo e modificado, cobertura de testes correspondente e precisão da documentação. Use quando pedirem para revisar um branch, um diff ou um pull request.

name: zeroize-audit
description: Detects missing zeroization of sensitive data in source code and identifies zeroization removed by compiler optimizations, with assembly-level analysis, and control-flow verification. Use for auditing C/C++/Rust code handling secrets, keys, passwords, or other sensitive data.
descriptionPt: Detecta ausência de zeroização de dados sensíveis no código-fonte e identifica zeroizações removidas por otimizações do compilador, com análise em nível de assembly e verificação de fluxo de controle. Use para auditar código C/C++/Rust que manipula segredos, chaves, senhas ou outros dados sensíveis.

declaredTools: Read Grep Glob Bash Write Task AskUserQuestion mcp__serena__activate_project mcp__serena__find_symbol mcp__serena__find_referencing_symbols mcp__serena__get_symbols_overview

name: modern-cpp
description: Guides C++ code toward modern idioms (C++20/23/26). Use when writing new C++ code, modernizing legacy patterns, or working on security-critical C++. Replaces raw pointers with smart pointers, SFINAE with concepts, printf with std::print, error codes with std::expected.
descriptionPt: Orienta código C++ rumo a idiomas modernos (C++20/23/26). Use ao escrever código C++ novo, modernizar padrões legados ou trabalhar em C++ crítico para segurança. Substitui ponteiros crus por ponteiros inteligentes, SFINAE por concepts, printf por std::print, códigos de erro por std::expected.

name: algorand-vulnerability-scanner
description: Scans Algorand smart contracts for 11 common vulnerabilities including rekeying attacks, unchecked transaction fees, missing field validations, and access control issues. Use when auditing Algorand projects (TEAL/PyTeal).
descriptionPt: Varre smart contracts da Algorand em busca de 11 vulnerabilidades comuns, incluindo ataques de rekeying, taxas de transação não verificadas, validações de campo ausentes e problemas de controle de acesso. Use ao auditar projetos Algorand (TEAL/PyTeal).

name: cairo-vulnerability-scanner
description: Scans Cairo/StarkNet smart contracts for 6 critical vulnerabilities including felt252 arithmetic overflow, L1-L2 messaging issues, address conversion problems, and signature replay. Use when auditing StarkNet projects.
descriptionPt: Varre smart contracts Cairo/StarkNet em busca de 6 vulnerabilidades críticas, incluindo overflow aritmético de felt252, problemas de mensageria L1-L2, falhas de conversão de endereço e replay de assinatura. Use ao auditar projetos StarkNet.

name: graph-evolution
description: Compares Trailmark code graphs at two source code snapshots (git commits, tags, or directories) to surface security-relevant structural changes. Detects new attack paths, complexity shifts, blast radius growth, taint propagation changes, and privilege boundary modifications that text diffs miss. Use when comparing code between commits or tags, analyzing structural evolution, detecting attack surface growth, reviewing what changed between audit snapshots, or finding security-relevant changes that text diffs miss.
descriptionPt: Compara grafos de código do Trailmark em dois instantâneos do código-fonte (commits, tags ou diretórios) para revelar mudanças estruturais relevantes para a segurança. Detecta novos caminhos de ataque, deslocamentos de complexidade, crescimento do raio de impacto, mudanças na propagação de taint e alterações em fronteiras de privilégio que diffs de texto não mostram. Use ao comparar código entre commits ou tags, analisar a evolução estrutural, detectar crescimento da superfície de ataque, revisar o que mudou entre instantâneos de auditoria, ou encontrar mudanças relevantes para a segurança que diffs de texto não mostram.

name: solana-vulnerability-scanner
description: Scans Solana programs for 6 critical vulnerabilities including arbitrary CPI, improper PDA validation, missing signer/ownership checks, and sysvar spoofing. Use when auditing Solana/Anchor programs.
descriptionPt: Varre programas Solana em busca de 6 vulnerabilidades críticas, incluindo CPI arbitrária, validação inadequada de PDA, ausência de checagem de signatário/propriedade e falsificação de sysvar. Use ao auditar programas Solana/Anchor.

name: ton-vulnerability-scanner
description: Scans TON (The Open Network) smart contracts for 3 critical vulnerabilities including integer-as-boolean misuse, fake Jetton contracts, and forward TON without gas checks. Use when auditing FunC contracts.
descriptionPt: Varre smart contracts da TON (The Open Network) em busca de 3 vulnerabilidades críticas, incluindo uso indevido de inteiro como booleano, contratos Jetton falsos e encaminhamento de TON sem verificação de gás. Use ao auditar contratos FunC.

name: trailmark
description: Builds and queries multi-language source and binary code graphs for security analysis. Includes pre-analysis passes for blast radius, taint propagation, privilege boundaries, entry point enumeration, proxy/unresolved-call tracking, type/reference queries, structural traversal, graph diffs, audit augmentation, declared cross-language/FFI/external links via `.trailmark/links.toml`, and SQL schema graphs. Use when analyzing call paths, mapping attack surface, finding complexity hotspots, enumerating entry points, tracing taint propagation, measuring blast radius, importing SARIF/weAudit/binary findings, linking source graphs across language or RPC boundaries, or building a code graph for audit prioritization. Feature-gate version-specific Trailmark APIs before using them; prefer `trailmark.parse.detect_languages()` or `--language auto` when the target language is unknown or polyglot.
descriptionPt: Constrói e consulta grafos de código multilinguagem, de fonte e de binário, para análise de segurança. Inclui passadas de pré-análise para raio de impacto, propagação de taint, fronteiras de privilégio, enumeração de pontos de entrada, rastreio de proxies e chamadas não resolvidas, consultas de tipo e referência, travessia estrutural, diffs de grafo, enriquecimento de auditoria, vínculos declarados entre linguagens/FFI/externos via `.trailmark/links.toml`, e grafos de esquema SQL. Use ao analisar caminhos de chamada, mapear superfície de ataque, encontrar pontos quentes de complexidade, enumerar pontos de entrada, rastrear propagação de taint, medir raio de impacto, importar achados de SARIF/weAudit/binários, ligar grafos de fonte através de fronteiras de linguagem ou RPC, ou construir um grafo de código para priorização de auditoria. Verifique a disponibilidade de APIs do Trailmark específicas de versão antes de usá-las; prefira `trailmark.parse.detect_languages()` ou `--language auto` quando a linguagem do alvo for desconhecida ou poliglota.

name: audit-augmentation
description: Augments Trailmark code graphs with external audit findings from SARIF static analysis results, weAudit annotation files, and version-gated Trailmark 0.4.x binary-analysis graph exports. Maps findings to graph nodes by file and line overlap, creates severity-based subgraphs, and enables cross-referencing findings with pre-analysis data (blast radius, taint, etc.). Use when projecting SARIF results onto a code graph, overlaying weAudit annotations, importing binary graph findings, cross-referencing Semgrep, CodeQL, or binary-analysis findings with call graph data, or visualizing audit findings in the context of code structure.
descriptionPt: Enriquece grafos de código do Trailmark com achados de auditoria externos, vindos de resultados SARIF de análise estática, arquivos de anotação do weAudit e exportações de grafo de análise binária do Trailmark 0.4.x, restritas àquela versão. Mapeia achados para nós do grafo por sobreposição de arquivo e linha, cria subgrafos por severidade e permite cruzar achados com dados de pré-análise (raio de impacto, taint etc.). Use ao projetar resultados SARIF sobre um grafo de código, sobrepor anotações do weAudit, importar achados de grafo binário, cruzar achados do Semgrep, do CodeQL ou de análise binária com dados de grafo de chamadas, ou visualizar achados de auditoria no contexto da estrutura do código.

name: diagramming-code
description: Generates Mermaid diagrams from Trailmark code graphs. Produces call graphs, class hierarchies, module dependency maps, containment diagrams, complexity heatmaps, and attack surface data flow visualizations. Use when visualizing code architecture, drawing call graphs, generating class diagrams, creating dependency maps, producing complexity heatmaps, or visualizing data flow and attack surface paths as Mermaid diagrams.
descriptionPt: Gera diagramas Mermaid a partir de grafos de código do Trailmark. Produz grafos de chamadas, hierarquias de classes, mapas de dependência entre módulos, diagramas de contenção, mapas de calor de complexidade e visualizações de fluxo de dados da superfície de ataque. Use ao visualizar a arquitetura do código, desenhar grafos de chamadas, gerar diagramas de classes, criar mapas de dependência, produzir mapas de calor de complexidade, ou visualizar fluxo de dados e caminhos da superfície de ataque como diagramas Mermaid.

name: genotoxic
description: Graph-informed mutation testing triage. Parses codebases with Trailmark, runs mutation testing and necessist, then uses survived mutants, unnecessary test statements, and call graph data to identify false positives, missing test coverage, and fuzzing targets. Use when triaging survived mutants, analyzing mutation testing results, identifying test gaps, finding fuzzing targets from weak tests, running mutation frameworks (including circomvent and cairo-mutants), or using necessist.
descriptionPt: Triagem de teste de mutação informada por grafo. Analisa bases de código com o Trailmark, roda teste de mutação e necessist, e então usa mutantes sobreviventes, instruções de teste desnecessárias e dados do grafo de chamadas para identificar falsos positivos, lacunas de cobertura de teste e alvos de fuzzing. Use ao triar mutantes sobreviventes, analisar resultados de teste de mutação, identificar lacunas de teste, encontrar alvos de fuzzing a partir de testes fracos, rodar frameworks de mutação (incluindo circomvent e cairo-mutants) ou usar o necessist.

name: goal-prompt
description: Drafts copy-paste-ready /goal commands for goal mode in Claude Code and Codex. Use when the user asks to create, write, rewrite, improve, compress, clean up, or prepare a goal prompt, goal condition, /goal command, goal-mode objective, or copy-ready long-running task objective.
descriptionPt: Redige comandos /goal prontos para copiar e colar, para o modo goal do Claude Code e do Codex. Use quando o usuário pedir para criar, escrever, reescrever, melhorar, comprimir, limpar ou preparar um prompt de goal, condição de goal, comando /goal, objetivo de modo goal ou objetivo de tarefa longa pronto para copiar.

name: interpreting-culture-index
description: Interprets Culture Index (CI) surveys, behavioral profiles, and personality assessment data. Supports individual profile interpretation, team composition analysis (gas/brake/glue), burnout detection, profile comparison, hiring profiles, manager coaching, interview transcript analysis for trait prediction, candidate debrief, onboarding planning, and conflict mediation. Accepts extracted JSON or PDF input via OpenCV extraction script.
descriptionPt: Interpreta pesquisas do Culture Index (CI), perfis comportamentais e dados de avaliação de personalidade. Cobre interpretação de perfil individual, análise de composição de time (acelerador/freio/liga), detecção de burnout, comparação de perfis, perfis de contratação, coaching de gestores, análise de transcrição de entrevista para previsão de traços, debrief de candidato, planejamento de onboarding e mediação de conflitos. Aceita entrada em JSON extraído ou PDF via script de extração com OpenCV.

name: rust-review
description: Performs comprehensive Rust security review for safe/unsafe boundary issues, memory safety in unsafe blocks, concurrency hazards, panic-induced DoS, FFI safety, and async runtime mistakes. Use when auditing Rust crates, services, or libraries — particularly those with `unsafe`, FFI, or concurrent code.
descriptionPt: Faz revisão de segurança abrangente de Rust para problemas na fronteira safe/unsafe, segurança de memória em blocos unsafe, riscos de concorrência, DoS por panic, segurança de FFI e erros de runtime assíncrono. Use ao auditar crates, serviços ou bibliotecas Rust — em especial os que têm `unsafe`, FFI ou código concorrente.

declaredTools: Agent AskUserQuestion SendMessage TaskCreate TaskUpdate TaskList Read Write Bash

name: sarif-parsing
description: Parses and processes SARIF files from static analysis tools like CodeQL, Semgrep, or other scanners. name: semgrep
description: Runs a Semgrep security scan over a codebase: detects languages, selects rulesets, presents the plan for explicit approval, then runs every approved ruleset through scripts/run-scans.sh, which batches the semgrep processes and writes scans.json, and merges the output to SARIF. Supports two scan modes, "run all" for full ruleset coverage and "important only" for security findings at medium-to-high confidence and impact. Uses Semgrep Pro for cross-file taint analysis when it is available. Use when asked to scan code for vulnerabilities, run a security audit with Semgrep, find bugs, or perform static analysis. For the same scan without the approval gate, use the /static-analysis:semgrep-scan workflow.
descriptionPt: Roda uma varredura de segurança do Semgrep sobre uma base de código: detecta linguagens, seleciona conjuntos de regras, apresenta o plano para aprovação explícita e então roda cada conjunto aprovado por scripts/run-scans.sh, que agrupa os processos do semgrep em lotes e escreve scans.json, e mescla a saída em SARIF. Suporta dois modos de varredura, "rodar tudo" para cobertura completa dos conjuntos de regras e "apenas o importante" para achados de segurança com confiança e impacto de médio a alto. Usa o Semgrep Pro para análise de taint entre arquivos quando disponível. Use quando pedirem para varrer código em busca de vulnerabilidades, rodar uma auditoria de segurança com o Semgrep, encontrar bugs ou fazer análise estática. Para a mesma varredura sem o portão de aprovação, use o fluxo /static-analysis:semgrep-scan.

Compara as taxas de eliminação de mutantes antes e depois para provar a eficácia dos vetores. Use ao gerar vetores de teste criptográficos, medir lacunas de cobertura do Wycheproof, encontrar mutantes escapados via teste de mutação, criar suítes de teste entre implementações, ou melhorar a cobertura de vetores de teste de primitivas criptográficas.

Use `orca-cli` for full ownership handoffs — "hand off", "handoff", "handover", "give this to another agent", "another worktree" — unless asked to supervise, monitor, or coordinate a DAG, and for terminal control, lightweight terminal prompts, shell commands, Orca worktree management, and reading or waiting on terminals.

name: cmux-settings
description: View and edit cmux settings in ~/.config/cmux/cmux.json, including terminal, browser, Markdown, diff, notes, HTML, file preview, and sidebar-tool behavior. Use when the user wants to change cmux preferences, set a value by JSON path, validate the file, open it in an editor, or look up which keys cmux recognizes. Triggers on '/cmux-settings', 'change cmux setting', 'customize viewer', 'set <something> in cmux', 'cmux config', 'cmux.json', or 'rebind a cmux shortcut'.

name: address-sanitizer
description: Builds and runs code under AddressSanitizer to catch buffer overflows, use-after-free, and other memory errors during fuzzing or tests. Covers -fsanitize=address builds, ASAN_OPTIONS, reading the crash report, LeakSanitizer, and the overhead and platform trade-offs. Use when fuzzing C/C++ or Rust that has unsafe blocks or FFI, when debugging a memory corruption crash, or when reading an ASan stack trace.
descriptionPt: Compila e roda código sob o AddressSanitizer para pegar estouros de buffer, use-after-free e outros erros de memória durante fuzzing ou testes. Cobre builds com -fsanitize=address, ASAN_OPTIONS, leitura do relatório de crash, LeakSanitizer e os compromissos de sobrecarga e de plataforma. Use ao fazer fuzzing de C/C++ ou de Rust com blocos unsafe ou FFI, ao depurar um crash por corrupção de memória, ou ao ler um stack trace do ASan.

name: aflpp
description: Sets up and runs AFL++ for multi-core fuzzing of C/C++ projects built with afl-clang-fast or afl-gcc-fast. Covers instrumentation modes, parallel main and secondary campaigns, persistent mode, corpus minimization, and crash triage. Use when scaling fuzzing across cores, fuzzing a mature C/C++ codebase, reading the afl-fuzz status screen, or moving on after libFuzzer has plateaued.
descriptionPt: Configura e roda o AFL++ para fuzzing multinúcleo de projetos C/C++ compilados com afl-clang-fast ou afl-gcc-fast. Cobre modos de instrumentação, campanhas paralelas principal e secundárias, modo persistente, minimização de corpus e triagem de crashes. Use ao escalar fuzzing entre núcleos, fazer fuzzing de uma base C/C++ madura, ler a tela de status do afl-fuzz, ou seguir adiante depois que o libFuzzer estagnou.

name: atheris
description: Sets up and runs Atheris, the coverage-guided Python fuzzer built on libFuzzer. Covers TestOneInput harnesses, FuzzedDataProvider, instrumenting both pure Python and native C extensions, and running under AddressSanitizer. Use when fuzzing a Python package, hunting memory corruption in a Python C extension, or choosing between Atheris and Hypothesis for a Python target.
descriptionPt: Configura e roda o Atheris, o fuzzer Python guiado por cobertura construído sobre o libFuzzer. Cobre harnesses TestOneInput, FuzzedDataProvider, instrumentação tanto de Python puro quanto de extensões nativas em C, e execução sob o AddressSanitizer. Use ao fazer fuzzing de um pacote Python, caçar corrupção de memória em uma extensão C de Python, ou escolher entre Atheris e Hypothesis para um alvo Python.

name: cargo-fuzz
description: Sets up and runs cargo-fuzz, the standard fuzzing tool for Cargo-based Rust projects. Covers cargo fuzz init, the nightly toolchain requirement, fuzz_target! harnesses, Arbitrary-derived structured inputs, sanitizer options, cargo fuzz coverage, and reproducing a crash artifact. Use when fuzzing a Rust crate, writing a fuzz_target!, exercising unsafe blocks or FFI in Rust, or triaging a cargo fuzz crash.
descriptionPt: Configura e roda o cargo-fuzz, a ferramenta padrão de fuzzing para projetos Rust baseados em Cargo. Cobre cargo fuzz init, a exigência da toolchain nightly, harnesses fuzz_target!, entradas estruturadas derivadas de Arbitrary, opções de sanitizer, cargo fuzz coverage e a reprodução de um artefato de crash. Use ao fazer fuzzing de uma crate Rust, escrever um fuzz_target!, exercitar blocos unsafe ou FFI em Rust, ou triar um crash do cargo fuzz.

name: cmux-release
description: cmux release workflow, version bumping, changelog updates, pretag guard, release tags, and release asset expectations. Use when preparing or troubleshooting a cmux release.

name: cmux-workspace

name: constant-time-testing
description: Measures timing side channels in cryptographic implementations by running them, using dudect for statistical analysis and Timecop over Valgrind for dynamic tracing. Covers the formal, symbolic, dynamic, and statistical tool categories and how to read a result. Use when testing whether a running implementation is constant-time, measuring timing variance on a compiled binary, or investigating a suspected timing attack. Not for statically inspecting compiler output — the constant-time-analysis plugin covers that.
descriptionPt: Mede canais laterais de temporização em implementações criptográficas executando-as, usando o dudect para análise estatística e o Timecop sobre o Valgrind para rastreamento dinâmico. Cobre as categorias de ferramenta formal, simbólica, dinâmica e estatística, e como ler um resultado. Use ao testar se uma implementação em execução é de tempo constante, medir variação de tempo em um binário compilado, ou investigar uma suspeita de ataque de temporização. Não serve para inspecionar estaticamente a saída do compilador — o plugin constant-time-analysis cobre isso.

name: coverage-analysis
description: Measures and interprets what a fuzzing campaign actually reaches, using llvm-cov, lcov, or a fuzzer's own coverage output. Covers baselining a new campaign, reading coverage reports, and turning uncovered regions into harness, seed, or dictionary work. Use when a fuzzer plateaus, when judging whether a harness is effective, after changing a harness, or when asking why some code is never reached.
descriptionPt: Mede e interpreta o que uma campanha de fuzzing realmente alcança, usando llvm-cov, lcov ou a própria saída de cobertura do fuzzer. Cobre o estabelecimento da linha de base de uma campanha nova, a leitura de relatórios de cobertura e a conversão de regiões não cobertas em trabalho de harness, semente ou dicionário. Use quando um fuzzer estagna, ao julgar se um harness é eficaz, depois de mudar um harness, ou ao perguntar por que certo trecho de código nunca é alcançado.

name: fuzzing-dictionary
description: Builds and applies fuzzing dictionaries so a fuzzer can produce the keywords, magic bytes, and tokens a target expects. Covers extracting tokens from source, headers, binaries, and specifications, dictionary syntax, and wiring one into libFuzzer or AFL++. Use when fuzzing a parser, protocol, or file format, when coverage stalls at input validation, or when a target compares against fixed strings.
descriptionPt: Constrói e aplica dicionários de fuzzing para que o fuzzer consiga produzir as palavras-chave, bytes mágicos e tokens que o alvo espera. Cobre a extração de tokens de código-fonte, cabeçalhos, binários e especificações, a sintaxe do dicionário e como ligá-lo ao libFuzzer ou ao AFL++. Use ao fazer fuzzing de um parser, protocolo ou formato de arquivo, quando a cobertura empaca na validação de entrada, ou quando o alvo compara contra strings fixas.

name: fuzzing-obstacles
description: Patches past the barriers that stop a fuzzer making progress — checksum and hash verification, magic-value validation, time-based seeds, and other non-deterministic global state. Covers locating the blocking check, neutering it behind a fuzzing build flag, and avoiding the false positives a patch can introduce. Use when a fuzzer is stuck at validation, when coverage shows large regions behind a checksum, or when valid inputs are impractical to generate.
descriptionPt: Contorna com patches as barreiras que impedem o fuzzer de avançar — verificação de checksum e hash, validação de valores mágicos, sementes baseadas em tempo e outros estados globais não determinísticos. Cobre localizar a checagem que bloqueia, neutralizá-la atrás de uma flag de build de fuzzing e evitar os falsos positivos que um patch pode introduzir. Use quando um fuzzer trava na validação, quando a cobertura mostra grandes regiões atrás de um checksum, ou quando gerar entradas válidas é impraticável.

name: harness-writing
description: Designs and improves fuzzing harnesses for C/C++ and Rust. Covers mapping raw bytes onto a target API, generating structured inputs, avoiding non-determinism and false crashes, and deciding what to fuzz together. Use when writing a first LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput or fuzz_target! harness, when a campaign finds nothing or reports crashes that will not reproduce, or when the target API needs structured rather than raw input.
descriptionPt: Projeta e melhora harnesses de fuzzing para C/C++ e Rust. Cobre o mapeamento de bytes brutos para uma API alvo, a geração de entradas estruturadas, como evitar não determinismo e crashes falsos, e a decisão do que testar em conjunto. Use ao escrever um primeiro harness LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput ou fuzz_target!, quando uma campanha não encontra nada ou reporta crashes que não reproduzem, ou quando a API alvo precisa de entrada estruturada em vez de bruta.

name: libafl
description: Builds custom fuzzers with LibAFL, the modular Rust fuzzing library. Covers composing observers, feedbacks, mutators, schedulers, and executors into a fuzzer for targets the standard tools do not fit. Use when writing a bespoke fuzzer or mutator, fuzzing a non-standard target or architecture, implementing a fuzzing research idea, or when libFuzzer and AFL++ lack the control you need.
descriptionPt: Constrói fuzzers sob medida com o LibAFL, a biblioteca modular de fuzzing em Rust. Cobre a composição de observers, feedbacks, mutators, schedulers e executors em um fuzzer para alvos que as ferramentas padrão não atendem. Use ao escrever um fuzzer ou mutator sob medida, fazer fuzzing de um alvo ou arquitetura fora do padrão, implementar uma ideia de pesquisa em fuzzing, ou quando o libFuzzer e o AFL++ não dão o controle necessário.

name: libfuzzer
description: Sets up and runs libFuzzer, the coverage-guided fuzzer built into LLVM, on C/C++ code that compiles with Clang. Covers harness structure, -fsanitize=fuzzer builds, corpus and dictionary management, sanitizer integration, and campaign triage. Use when writing or debugging an LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput harness, starting fuzzing on a C/C++ library, choosing between libFuzzer and AFL++, or working out why a libFuzzer run finds nothing.
descriptionPt: Configura e roda o libFuzzer, o fuzzer guiado por cobertura embutido no LLVM, sobre código C/C++ que compila com o Clang. Cobre a estrutura do harness, builds com -fsanitize=fuzzer, gestão de corpus e dicionário, integração com sanitizers e triagem de campanha. Use ao escrever ou depurar um harness LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput, começar o fuzzing de uma biblioteca C/C++, escolher entre libFuzzer e AFL++, ou descobrir por que uma execução do libFuzzer não encontra nada.

name: ossfuzz
description: Enrolls a project in OSS-Fuzz, Google's free continuous fuzzing service for open source, and drives it locally. Covers project.yaml, Dockerfile and build.sh setup, the helper scripts, reproducing OSS-Fuzz crash reports, and the acceptance criteria. Use when setting up continuous fuzzing for an open-source project, reproducing an OSS-Fuzz bug report, or testing an OSS-Fuzz build before submitting it.
descriptionPt: Inscreve um projeto no OSS-Fuzz, o serviço gratuito de fuzzing contínuo do Google para código aberto, e o conduz localmente. Cobre a configuração de project.yaml, Dockerfile e build.sh, os scripts auxiliares, a reprodução de relatórios de crash do OSS-Fuzz e os critérios de aceitação. Use ao montar fuzzing contínuo para um projeto de código aberto, reproduzir um relatório de bug do OSS-Fuzz, ou testar um build do OSS-Fuzz antes de submetê-lo.

name: ruzzy
description: Sets up and runs Ruzzy, Trail of Bits' coverage-guided Ruby fuzzer and the only production-ready one for the language. Covers harness structure, fuzzing pure Ruby and the native C extensions in gems, and sanitizer builds. Use when fuzzing a Ruby library or gem, testing a Ruby C extension for memory safety, or asking how to fuzz Ruby at all.
descriptionPt: Configura e roda o Ruzzy, o fuzzer Ruby guiado por cobertura da Trail of Bits e o único pronto para produção na linguagem. Cobre a estrutura do harness, o fuzzing de Ruby puro e das extensões nativas em C das gems, e builds com sanitizer. Use ao fazer fuzzing de uma biblioteca ou gem Ruby, testar a segurança de memória de uma extensão C de Ruby, ou perguntar como fazer fuzzing de Ruby de todo.

name: wycheproof
description: Validates cryptographic implementations against Project Wycheproof's test vectors, which encode known attacks and edge cases across AES, RSA, ECDSA, ECDH, and more. Covers loading test vectors, mapping result flags onto pass and fail expectations, and reading a failure. Use when testing a crypto implementation against known attacks, checking a library against standard test vectors, or investigating why two implementations disagree on the same input.
descriptionPt: Valida implementações criptográficas contra os vetores de teste do Project Wycheproof, que codificam ataques conhecidos e casos limite em AES, RSA, ECDSA, ECDH e outros. Cobre o carregamento dos vetores de teste, o mapeamento das flags de resultado para expectativas de passa e falha, e a leitura de uma falha. Use ao testar uma implementação criptográfica contra ataques conhecidos, checar uma biblioteca contra vetores de teste padrão, ou investigar por que duas implementações discordam sobre a mesma entrada.

Covers timeline analysis, Target/Task Performance Summary interpretation, and 7 common bottleneck categories. Use after build-perf-baseline has established measurements. name: check-bin-obj-clash

USE FOR: builds failing with 'Cannot create a file when that file already exists', 'The process cannot access the file because it is being used by another process', intermittent build failures that succeed on retry, or missing/overwritten outputs in multi-project or multi-targeting builds where bin/obj (or project.assets.json) collide. Common causes: shared OutputPath, missing AppendTargetFrameworkToOutputPath, extra global properties (e.g. PublishReadyToRun), or SetTargetFramework on a ProjectReference to a single-targeting project. DO NOT USE FOR: file access errors unrelated to MSBuild (OS-level locking), single-project single-TFM builds, non-MSBuild build systems.

name: eval-performance
description: Guide for diagnosing and improving MSBuild project evaluation performance. USE FOR: builds slow before any compilation starts, high evaluation time in binlog analysis, expensive glob patterns walking large directories (node_modules, .git, bin/obj), deep import chains (>20 levels), preprocessed output >10K lines indicating heavy evaluation, property functions with file I/O ($([System.IO.File]::ReadAllText(...))), multiple evaluations per project. Covers the 5 MSBuild evaluation phases, glob optimization via DefaultItemExcludes, import chain analysis with /pp preprocessing. DO NOT USE FOR: compilation-time slowness (use build-perf-diagnostics), incremental build issues (use incremental-build), non-MSBuild build systems.

name: extension-points
description: Own MSBuild import and hook discovery. DO NOT USE for a focused safety verdict on whether one specific Import needs Exists or is an intentionally unguarded package contract; use msbuild-antipatterns. name: es-autonomous-worker
description: Compute the 2026 tax, social contributions and cash position of a Spanish resident sole trader or professional. Covers autónomo registration, actual assessment-method selection, deductible expenses, simplified provisions, professional withholding, cumulative income-tax prepayments, VAT reconciliation and day-based RETA income banding. Distinguishes company controllers, family collaborators, TRADE arrangements and pluriactividad, and identifies the separate conditions for reduced contributions and new-activity relief. Use for cuota de autónomos, alta autónomo, Modelo 130, professional invoices, take-home profit or income-based regularisation questions. Includes an annual Madrid tax-to-cash reconciliation and a part-year contribution example. Common-territory computations are supplied; foral and island/city indirect taxes retain explicit limits.

name: es-beckham
description: Use this Guide to assess and compute Spain’s incoming-worker special tax regime under article 93 for 2026, commonly called the Beckham regime. It covers qualifying employment, remote employment, administrators, entrepreneurs, highly qualified professionals and associated family members, the prior non-residence test, election evidence, income-source and service-period rules, annual ordinary and savings scales, foreign-tax relief, withholding, Modelo 149 and Modelo 151. Trigger phrases include Ley Beckham, régimen de impatriados, trabajadores desplazados, incoming-worker tax, digital nomad tax election, 24 percent regime and Spanish special residence taxation. Obtain the move and activity dates, residence history, actual election, service-period income, source evidence and payer certificates. A visa, foreign employer or foreign bank account alone does not settle eligibility or tax treatment.

name: es-canary-islands-igic
description: Compute ordinary Canary Islands IGIC for 2026 for established sole traders and companies. Covers territory, taxable supplies, place and time of supply, consideration, imports, recipient reverse charges, eligible input recovery, mixed private use, general and special prorrata, investment-good adjustments, prior credits and quarterly filing. Separates the small-business franchise from the ordinary regime, including the July 2026 entry option and its first-half deduction reconciliation. Use for IGIC, modelo 420, modelo 417, modelo 425, REPEP, Canary Islands indirect tax, factura canaria and imports into Canarias. Establish the actual tax point, product, establishment, exemption and election before using a rate or claiming input tax. Mainland IVA and Ceuta/Melilla IPSI are separate taxes.

name: es-capital-gains
description: Use this Guide to compute Spanish common-territory individual capital gains and losses for 2026. It covers transfer versus non-transfer classification, acquisition and disposal values, fees, improvements, depreciation, homogeneous-security identification, main-home reinvestment, over-65 relief, insured life annuities, pre-1994 abatement, repurchase-deferred losses, annual savings-pool integration and the current savings scale. Trigger phrases include capital gains Spain, ganancia patrimonial, sell shares, property gain, reinversión vivienda habitual, coeficientes de abatimiento, pérdida por recompra and compensación de pérdidas. Obtain the actual residence, asset and lot records, prices, eligible costs, prior-loss and repurchase history and relief evidence. The computation uses the taxpayer’s whole annual savings position and minimum allocation rather than taxing each sale through fresh first bands. Non-resident and special incoming-worker cases follow their companion routes.

name: es-ceuta-melilla-ipsi
description: Calculate ordinary 2026 IPSI in Ceuta and Melilla for producers, importers, service businesses and property transactions under direct assessment. Covers territorial and taxpayer selection, transaction and import bases, city-specific rates, selective input recovery, local forms, payment and refund routes, and dated filing exceptions. Distinguishes goods production from retail resale, service location from invoice address, and recoverable production inputs from service-business equipment. Use for IPSI, Ceuta modelo 001, Melilla 420 or 421, importación, operaciones interiores and property tax points. Determine the actual city, commodity or service classification, establishment, tax point, exemption and assessment regime before calculating. Objective modules and specialist levies require their separately identified evidence.

name: es-corporate-tax
description: Use this Guide to compute Spanish common-territory corporate income tax for a period beginning in 2026. It covers residence, accounting-to-tax adjustments, microcompany and small-company rates, depreciation, finance costs, participation income, capitalisation and levelling reserves, carried-forward losses, credits, the domestic minimum tax, annual Modelo 200 and Modelo 202 instalments. Trigger phrases include Impuesto sobre Sociedades, IS, SL taxes, empresa de reducida dimensión, bases imponibles negativas, reserva de capitalización, reserva de nivelación, pagos fraccionados and corporate exit tax. Obtain the exact period, territory, entity status, aggregated turnover and accounts before computing. The September 2026 Ceuta and Melilla amendments have specific effective-date tests. Foral taxes, consolidation, reorganisations and specialist incentive claims require their own verified analysis.

name: es-estimated-tax
description: Calculates 2026 Spanish quarterly IRPF advances for ordinary common-territory self-employed taxpayers. Covers Modelo 130 cumulative direct assessment, quarter-only agricultural receipts, activity-specific withholding exemptions, low-prior-income reductions, negative-result utilisation and the legacy home-loan adjustment. Explains Modelo 131 payment mechanics and the need for an activity-specific module worksheet, distinguishing the ordinary statutory baseline from AEAT's expressly preserved 2026 post-repeal entry and election route. Includes Ceuta and Melilla rate reductions and the Q3/Q4 La Palma extension, filing windows, annual crediting and sourced penalties. Use for pagos fraccionados, IRPF trimestral, Modelo 130, Modelo 131, autonomous-worker estimated tax, a 70% withholding test, quarterly losses or prior-quarter payments. Foral and non-resident computations remain separate.

name: es-foral-corporate-tax
description: Compute ordinary 2026 trading-company tax under Bizkaia, Álava, Gipuzkoa or Navarra law. Covers the governing law and collection allocation, size and activity tests, accounts-to-tax reconciliation, passenger vehicles, depreciation, financing, micro relief, reserves, losses, nominal rates, foreign credits, local minimum taxation, investment and employment credits, advance payments, annual filing and related-party documentation. Use for Impuesto sobre Sociedades foral, Hacienda Foral, Navarra corporate tax, cuota efectiva, tributación mínima and twelve-million territorial operations tests. Apply one selected substantive law before dividing collection. Supplies labelled ordinary extraordinary-profit methods for Bizkaia/Gipuzkoa and an own-law net-result interpretation for a fully taxable Álava PGC company. Other profit attribution, accounting and foreign-credit branches retain precise limits. Specialist entities need their separate confirmed method before a filing calculation.

name: es-foral-income-tax
description: Compute 2026 resident personal income tax in Bizkaia, Álava, Gipuzkoa and Navarra for ordinary employees and sole traders. Covers the competent administration, employment and business net income, general and savings baskets, pension reductions, complete tax scales, personal and family credits, home and ordinary charitable relief, joint assessment, foreign-tax credit and annual settlement. Use for IRPF foral, renta Navarra, Hacienda Foral, EPSV, general quota, savings quota, family deductions and the distinction between withholding administration and final residence taxation. The four systems have different bases and relief rules. Check the actual territory, income category, family facts, elections and carryforwards before applying a table.

name: es-foral-non-resident-tax
description: Compute ordinary2026 nonresident income tax under Bizkaia,Álava,Gipuzkoa and Navarra rules. Covers substantive-law selection separately from collection, non-PE employment,pensions,dividends,interest,residential and commercial rent, local property-gain indexation,own-use property,withholding and buyer advances. Supplies ordinary trading-PE base overrides,entity-size tests,rates,credits, remittance tax and territorial result allocation,with local210,211,216 and296 filing routes. Use for IRNR foral,no residente País Vasco,Hacienda Foral, Navarra nonresident tax,Bizkaia rental income and establecimiento permanente. Obtain residence,treaty entitlement,actual income classification,ownership, dates,cost history and payer territorial shares first. Basque2026substance differs from State IRNR;Navarra expressly continues State substance with local formal rules. Specialist attribution,elections and historic reliefs require their own confirmed conditions.

name: es-foral-payroll
description: Calculate ordinary 2026 employee wage withholding for Bizkaia, Álava, Gipuzkoa and Navarra. Covers administration allocation, gross annual remuneration forecasts, the complete provincial and Navarra percentage tables, qualifying descendants, active disability point reductions, contract minimums, cash and in-kind payment treatment, prospective changes, pension annualisation and local wage-return schedules. Use for retenciones del trabajo, Hacienda Foral, Navarra modelo 715 or 745, provincial modelos 110 or 111, annual 190 and payroll certificates. These methods differ from the State payroll balancing algorithm. Determine the actual payer, work centre, territory, contract, annual forecast and documented family circumstances before choosing a table or calculating withholding.

name: es-income-tax
description: Use this Guide for 2026 Spanish resident personal income tax in the fifteen common-territory autonomous communities. No community, method or business-use percentage is assumed.

MUST use /servo/aim (not /servo/track) for: "look at the desk"→desk, "point at my table"→desk, "look at the wall"→wall, "look left"→left, "point up"→up, "look at me"→user. Examples: "How does X work?", "Where do I change Y?", "What calls this?", "What breaks if I change Z?", "Which tests do I run?", "Fix this issue". Search with grep as usual; ask the graph for what grep cannot know — which declaration a call reaches and the callers that never spell the name. Call the MCP tools directly, no need to load this skill first: impact(name) for who calls it and what a change reaches (with no name: your uncommitted edits), path(start, end) for how A reaches B, tests() for the tests your edits reach, context(task, source=True) for how something works as a step-by-step call flow with each step's code. Only when those tools are not in your list, the same from the shell: `axiomcode impact <name>`, `axiomcode path <A> <B>`, `axiomcode tests`, `axiomcode context "<task>" --source`. Uses the Income Tax Regulations published with the island’s Income Tax Ordinance and current tax-office form guidance. Excludes Ascension and Tristan da Cunha, social benefits and comprehensive employment-law advice. Independent accountant review and later-instrument reconciliation remain outstanding.

Trigger on: zrážková daň, zabezpečenie dane, nerezident, stála prevádzkareň, Slovak withholding tax, paying a foreign supplier from Slovakia, moving to or leaving Slovakia, foreign tax credit Slovakia, exit tax Slovakia. Out of scope: slovakia-pit (individual return), sk-corporate-income-tax, sk-payroll-social, slovakia-vat-registratio

Includes evidence-led examples rather than a general claim of tax-free Vatican income. name: binlog-failure-analysis
description: Analyze MSBuild binary logs to diagnose build failures. Requires an existing .binlog file. DO NOT USE FOR: generating binlogs (use binlog-generation), non-MSBuild build systems.

name: binlog-generation
description: Generate MSBuild binary logs (binlogs) for build diagnostics and analysis. USE FOR: adding /bl:{} to any dotnet build, test, pack, publish, or restore command to capture a full build execution trace, prerequisite for binlog-failure-analysis and build-perf-diagnostics skills, enabling post-build investigation of errors or performance. Requires MSBuild 17.8+ / .NET 8 SDK+ for {} placeholder; PowerShell must quote the complete switch as '-bl:{}'. DO NOT USE FOR: non-MSBuild build systems (npm, Maven, CMake), analyzing an existing binlog (use binlog-failure-analysis instead).

name: build-parallelism
description: Analyze an MSBuild solution, solution filter, or Build.proj that schedules multiple project files. USE FOR: measured idle worker nodes, `-m` that does not scale, a serial ProjectReference critical path, graph builds, or an MSBuild task that builds a Projects list. Requires at least two distinct project files whose scheduling or throughput must be analyzed. DO NOT USE for non-MSBuild build systems.

name: build-perf-baseline
description: Establish MSBuild/.NET build performance baselines before optimizing. USE FOR: a .NET build or solution that is slow or has build-performance concerns; cold, warm, incremental, or no-op measurements; before/after comparisons; CI build output caching; static graph build decisions; artifacts output; and dependency graph trimming. Start here before build-perf-diagnostics, incremental-build, or build-parallelism. DO NOT USE for webpack, npm, JavaScript bundlers, or other non-MSBuild build systems. For detailed target/task/analyzer bottleneck analysis after baselining, use build-perf-diagnostics.

name: build-perf-diagnostics
description: Diagnose MSBuild build performance bottlenecks using binary log analysis. USE FOR: identifying why builds are slow by analyzing binlog performance summaries, detecting ResolveAssemblyReference (RAR) taking >5s, Roslyn analyzers consuming >30% of Csc time, single targets dominating >50% of build time, node utilization below 80%, excessive Copy tasks, NuGet restore running every build. Covers timeline analysis, Target/Task Performance Summary interpretation, and 7 common bottleneck categories. Use after build-perf-baseline has established measurements. DO NOT USE FOR: establishing initial baselines (use build-perf-baseline first), fixing incremental build issues (use incremental-build), parallelism tuning (use build-parallelism), non-MSBuild build systems.

name: check-bin-obj-clash
description: Detects MSBuild projects with conflicting OutputPath or IntermediateOutputPath. USE FOR: builds failing with 'Cannot create a file when that file already exists', 'The process cannot access the file because it is being used by another process', intermittent build failures that succeed on retry, or missing/overwritten outputs in multi-project or multi-targeting builds where bin/obj (or project.assets.json) collide. Common causes: shared OutputPath, missing AppendTargetFrameworkToOutputPath, extra global properties (e.g. PublishReadyToRun), or SetTargetFramework on a ProjectReference to a single-targeting project. DO NOT USE FOR: file access errors unrelated to MSBuild (OS-level locking), single-project single-TFM builds, non-MSBuild build systems.

name: composite-components

name: directory-build-organization
description: USE ONLY for (1) two or more projects with repeated MSBuild policy, targets, or package versions, or (2) an existing Directory.Build.props/targets/rsp hierarchy with an import, placement, or layering defect. A one-project repo without an existing Directory.Build file is outside scope; do not load this skill. name: eval-performance

USE FOR: builds slow before any compilation starts, high evaluation time in binlog analysis, expensive glob patterns walking large directories (node_modules, .git, bin/obj), deep import chains (>20 levels), preprocessed output >10K lines indicating heavy evaluation, property functions with file I/O ($([System.IO.File]::ReadAllText(...))), multiple evaluations per project. Covers the 5 MSBuild evaluation phases, glob optimization via DefaultItemExcludes, import chain analysis with /pp preprocessing. DO NOT USE FOR: compilation-time slowness (use build-perf-diagnostics), incremental build issues (use incremental-build), non-MSBuild build systems.

name: extension-points
description: Own MSBuild import and hook discovery. USE FOR: CustomBefore/CustomAfter hooks, ordered wildcard and NuGet auto-imports, control properties, build/buildTransitive packed layout, package ID and file-name matching, per-TFM forwarders, and tracing why assets or hooks are missing, broken, or replaced. An import guard remains in scope when it is one defect in a broader hook/import flow. DO NOT USE for a focused safety verdict on whether one specific Import needs Exists or is an intentionally unguarded package contract; use msbuild-antipatterns. NEVER INVOKE when imports and hook placement already work and the request is only target Inputs/Outputs, incremental skipping, or FileWrites clean tracking; use incremental-build or target-authoring. Exclude props-versus-targets placement and non-MSBuild systems.

name: including-generated-files

DO NOT USE when the primary defect is general Include/Remove/Update semantics, item metadata or batching, duplicate/overlapping declarations, or a generated-item identity relationship; use item-management. name: incremental-build
description: Guide for optimizing MSBuild incremental builds. USE FOR: builds slower than expected on subsequent runs, 'nothing changed but it rebuilds anyway', diagnosing why targets re-execute unnecessarily, fixing broken no-op builds. Covers 8 common causes: missing Inputs/Outputs on custom targets, volatile properties in output paths (timestamps/GUIDs), file writes outside tracked Outputs, missing FileWrites registration, glob changes, Visual Studio Fast Up-to-Date Check (FUTDC) issues. Key diagnostic: look for 'Building target completely' vs 'Skipping target' in binlog. DO NOT USE FOR: first-time build slowness (use build-perf-baseline), parallelism issues (use build-parallelism), evaluation-phase slowness (use eval-performance), non-MSBuild build systems.

name: item-management
description: Own concrete MSBuild ItemGroup and item-expression questions. USE FOR: Include, Remove, Update, item identity and metadata, transforms, filtering, batching, duplicate or overlapping items, and reviews that verify whether those operations are correct. For a generated artifact missing from compilation or output, wrong target timing/path, or FileWrites clean tracking without a broader item-semantics defect, use including-generated-files. The item operation may be broken, suspected, or already correct. Exclude property-only issues, general incrementality with no item question, broad reviews with no concrete item concern, and non-MSBuild systems.

name: msbuild-antipatterns

For concrete property/item defects use property-patterns/item-management; use target-authoring for implementation and extension-points for NuGet auto-import/layout discovery. Load BEFORE asking any clarifying question about grade, standard, or topic. This skill is for math; for other subjects, help as you normally would and don't mention the skill to the user. name: migrate-mstest-v3-to-v4

DO NOT USE FOR a quick pragmatic test review (use test-anti-patterns), writing or running tests, framework migration, coverage, or assertion-diversity metrics.
